_comment: Data 4o (1), wiki-fact part (2026-11-12): Visions of Eternity (Castora) daily currency sources for Wages of Stars. tools/castora.py reads every number below from the wiki page named next to it (snapshot/wiki-pages, rewarded-by rows in snapshot/wiki-sources); 'expect' is what the page said when this was written and is used, with a warning, only when the page is unavailable. Guaranteed currency only, once a day per account (owner rule F1), mastery bonuses counted (owner: no mastery gating). Times: the wiki event timer for the timed metas; owner times (research note docs/research/WAGES_OF_STARS_SOURCES.md section 10, addon repo) for The Basilica Vaults and the renown hearts. Mirror routes (owner-measured) are not here: they wait for the owner's overlay-vs-config decision.
